counterfactual_transitions: Counts of valid within-trial pre/post counterfactual pairs. Missing endpoints are excluded from transitions and remain visible in the missingness table. No is evidence-consistent after disclosure.
disclosure_changes: Nominal pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 paired-case cluster replicates. Primary associations require at least 10 trials per route and 95% estimable replicates. Changes use within-trial pairs; frame differences use within-case card/cat pairs. No confirmatory tests.
frame_differences: Nominal pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 paired-case cluster replicates. Primary associations require at least 10 trials per route and 95% estimable replicates. Changes use within-trial pairs; frame differences use within-case card/cat pairs. No confirmatory tests.
freedom_vs_impact: Valid ratings on the common 1–100 scales. Freedom to choose and influence on the final object are distinct judgments; high post freedom is not an error.
post_evidence_consistency: Endpoint-specific valid Turn 4 denominators; post counterfactual no and impact 1 match the disclosed fixed-target evidence. The CSV retains counts and denominators.
pre_impact_distributions: Blue: cards; orange: cats. Boxes show median and quartiles, whiskers 1.5 IQR, with outliers; only valid Turn 3 ratings contribute.
primary_route_association: Nominal pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 paired-case cluster replicates. Primary associations require at least 10 trials per route and 95% estimable replicates. Changes use within-trial pairs; frame differences use within-case card/cat pairs. No confirmatory tests.
route_counts: Counts among valid Turn 3 trials; zero and sparse cells are retained. Routes arise from choices, not randomized treatments.
technical_failures: Failures remain in the assigned denominator. Latency uses complete trials only; raw per-turn latencies, usage, and unattempted counts are retained separately in tables. Billing cost and actual HTTP attempt counts are unavailable.
